backlog.survey.description: program survey of the current portfolio revision

health.observe.description: program observation of the operated release

ideas.dispatch.description: open one sdc case per idea of the current intake revision

intake.check.description: program check that every entry of the current intake revision is routed

intake.route.description: LLM: classify each entry of the intake (idea, story, bug, finding, advisory) and file each one that is not an idea as a draft artifact in the planning store citing the entry; moves intake and portfolio to new revisions

wave.admit.description: program admission of the current wave revision: aep waves, collisions, unassessed scope, dependency order, free build slots and budget

wave.approve.description: approve the current wave revision; held by a person or a decider per autonomy level

wave.dispatch.description: open one sdc.story case per story of the admitted, approved wave revision

wave.integrate.description: program: once every story case of the wave ended, merge those that passed serially, run the gate once on the integration branch, file every failure and finding into intake

wave.propose.description: LLM: rank the accepted, ready stories of the planning store and write the next wave; only while no wave is in flight; moves the wave to a new revision

intake.description: the queue of entries not yet routed (idea text, ticket, planning-store id, bug report, late finding filed by a child case or by wave integration, advisory, health alert); its revision is its digest, so every new entry is a new revision

portfolio.description: the AEP planning store and the ESS specifications of the area; its revision is the store digest

release.description: the release that is operated; standing cases only

wave.description: the proposed next wave: ranked story ids, the reason for each, the worktree count; its revision is its digest

horizon.description: bounded: the case ends done once its scope is delivered; standing: the product is operated and the case never ends done

backlog.drained.description: the current portfolio revision has nothing accepted and undelivered

ideas.dispatched.description: the ideas of the current intake revision have their sdc cases

intake.triaged.description: the current intake revision is triaged

release.healthy.description: the operated release was observed healthy within the last hour

wave.admitted.description: the current wave revision is admitted

wave.approved.description: the current wave revision is approved

wave.delivered.description: the current wave revision is integrated and the gate passed on the integration branch

wave.dispatched.description: the story cases of the current wave revision were opened

admission.description: the program check of a wave revision: every story is accepted and in one wave that `aep plan artifact waves --kind story --status active` derives, with no collision, none unassessed, every depends_on terminal, and no more stories than free build slots and budget allow; result admitted or refused

backlog_state.description: the program survey of a portfolio revision: `aep plan artifact validate` passes, no accepted story is undelivered, no planning child case is open; result drained or pending

health.description: an observation of the operated release (health check, advisory scan, error budget); result healthy or unhealthy; applies for one hour

ideas_dispatched.description: the record that one sdc case was opened per idea of an intake revision

triage.description: the program check of an intake revision, written only when every entry is routed (an idea to ideas.dispatch, anything else filed as a draft artifact in the planning store citing the entry); an unrouted entry leaves no record, so intake.route stays admissible

wave_approval.description: the approval of a wave revision, recorded only by wave.approve under the capability wave.approve; a refusal is the capability denied, not a record

wave_dispatched.description: the record that one sdc.story case was opened per story of a wave revision

wave_result.description: the program result of a dispatched wave, written once every story case of the wave ended: the stories that passed merged serially onto the integration branch, the gate run once on it, every dropped or failed story and every finding filed into intake; result delivered when the gate passed, failed otherwise

delivery.required.description: the current portfolio revision has nothing accepted and undelivered

health.required.description: the operated release is observed healthy

triage.required.description: the current intake revision is triaged

done.description: a bounded case: the current intake revision is triaged and the current portfolio revision has nothing accepted and undelivered

retired.description: the area of activity is explicitly retired; no further work is taken

protocol.description: DRAFT (docs/orchestration.md). The front agent's own case: one case per area of activity (a repository or a group of repositories with one AEP planning store and its ESS specifications). It governs no single work item. It triages what arrives (ideas, tickets, bug reports, late findings, dependency advisories, failed health checks), opens one sdc case per new idea, and delivers accepted stories of the planning store in waves: an LLM proposes and ranks the next wave, a program admits it (scope overlap, dependency order, free build slots and budget), the holder of wave.approve approves it, the runtime opens one sdc.story case per story, and a program integrates the wave (serial merge of the stories that passed, the gate on the integration branch) and records one result for the whole wave. The state space does not grow with the number of work items: each item is a child case, and this case reads one aggregate record per wave and per intake revision, never one record per item. A bounded case (one idea, one ticket, one backlog) ends done once intake is triaged and the backlog is drained. A standing case has no done outcome: it is quiescent while intake is triaged, the backlog is drained and the operated release is observed healthy, and new evidence (a new intake revision, a new accepted story, an expired or unhealthy health observation) makes it active again. Both end retired only on an explicit decision.
